title: 超越巅峰，INCOLOR全产品阵容亮相上海展
notes: Contemporaneous trade coverage identifies SS and SS+ as INCOLOR's 2025 Speedster models. The current manufacturer catalog and official store instead identify SR and SR+ as the purchasable Speedster models. No manufacturer discontinuation announcement was found, so this source supports historical identity only, not a precise end-of-sale date or a claim that SR/SR+ are mechanically identical successors.
